newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates widen, one-week up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates widen, one-week up.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound widened on Wednesday in the private-sector market to a range of seven and 8-1/2 percent, from 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent on Tuesday, bankers said.
Two out of the four bankers contacted said they had one week deals. They put the rates at eight and 8-3/4 percent, compared to between 7-1/2 and 8-3/4 on Tuesday.
"Everybody will wait until tomorrow (Thursday) to see the results of the 91-day t-bills," said one banker. "The market could be liquid tomorrow."
He said the market was also short because banks will be open only on Tuesday and Wednesday next week because of holidays.
Public sector banks maintained their 10-1/2 percent rate.
